[[Seed 2011]] Opening Words are modified from our [[Weekly Service Calls]].

Not sure what to say at the beginning . . . could Brandon make some kind of statement like, "We're so glad you're here. Everyone here brings their own journey and their own story. The three of us wanted to share a story that is important to us -- 

[The lights are out and if possible shades drawn. The first slide is a black screen. Ben and Brandon stand with their backs to everyone, hands clasped behind them, heads bowed. Shelley stands in front of them, facing the group.]

<big>Shelley: ''Once there was nothing.''</big> [Shelley then turns around to join the three with backs to group. A little time goes by before Ben speaks.]
 
Ben: [Turns to face the group. Draws out pauses.] ''Nothing ... Still ... Nothing''

Brandon: [Turns to face the group.] ''And then ...'' <gasp> ''Something!!!!'' [Right when he says "something," Ben triggers the first slide. The next 5 lines are delivered with energy and rapidly, like popcorn popping. If the computer is quick, maybe we could have an "autoadvance" for these 5 quick words -- otherwise I think we should stay with one slide for all 5 words.]

Shelley:  [Turns] ''Time,''

Ben: ''Space,''

Brandon: ''Matter,''

All: ''Energy,''

Ben: ''Gravity.''

Brandon: ''Galaxies coalesce ... in the celestial nursery, stars are born. And for every star, there is a story.'' 

Shelley: ''Our story began with Sol, the sun, the fire that sparks life into being.'' [Shelley lights the chalice.]
 
Brandon: ''Next came the Earth, our home, both the shaper of life and the clay from which life makes itself.'' [He plants a seed in the soil.]
 
Ben: ''Then came the water, the sea where the first life swam, the sea that swims inside each of us.'' [He drinks from a glass, then pours some water on the seed, then places the half-full glass beside the soil.]
 
Shelley: ''Finally life made the air, turning sunlight into fuel, freely available to all breathing creatures. [All three take three deep breaths, motioning for the group to join in. Shelley holds up 3 fingers, then 2, then 1 to mark how many breaths we've taken.]

Ben: ''Fire, Earth, Water, Air.''

Brandon: ''May our journey continue.''
